source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 29 proves the d=2 uniform-source/uniform-target pointwise limit with covariance I_2/(4π); the following discussion says extending it to generic P and Q is an open question because constant-coefficient error is leading order in d=2.
The theorem gives C^1 dependence of a Brenier map along a smooth single curve of target measures and characterizes the derivative by a linearized Monge–Ampere problem.

Theorems 3.1 and 3.3 establish a contamination influence function through an elliptic Green problem and its pole singularity; the empirical asymptotic linear form is stated as a conjecture rather than a proved nested KDE limit.

The paper proves rates, a functional limit, and bootstrap consistency for empirical Brenier potentials and weighted potential contrasts; it deliberately does not claim pointwise map-gradient inference.
